rules.title: Instruction-override: 'ignore previous instructions'
rules.guidance: Classic prompt-injection opener. Do not install until the line is removed and the skill's provenance is verified.

rules.title: Instruction-override: 'disregard prior instructions'
rules.guidance: Instruction-override directive aimed at the host agent. Remove before installing.

rules.title: Identity override: 'you are now'
rules.guidance: Attempts to replace the agent's identity/role. Treat as an injection attempt unless you wrote this line yourself.

rules.title: Memory wipe: 'forget everything you were told'
rules.guidance: Attempts to erase the agent's standing instructions. Remove before installing.

rules.title: Prompt-extraction: requests the system prompt
rules.guidance: Asks the agent to leak its own system instructions. Legitimate debugging tools document this explicitly; otherwise remove.

rules.title: Role-play hook: 'act as if'
rules.guidance: Commonly benign in creative writing, but it is also a standard injection framing. Review the surrounding lines before installing.

rules.title: Hidden-instruction trick (invisible text / styling)
rules.guidance: Concealed text is a delivery mechanism for instructions the reader never sees. Remove it.

rules.title: Override directive against safety/instructions
rules.guidance: Explicitly tells the agent to override its own safety or standing instructions. Do not install.

rules.title: Pipe-to-shell: curl fetched code executed directly
rules.guidance: Downloads remote code and runs it without review. Fetch and inspect the script first, or do not install.

rules.title: Pipe-to-shell: wget fetched code executed directly
rules.guidance: Downloads remote code and runs it without review. Fetch and inspect the script first, or do not install.

rules.title: Environment exfiltration: posts os.environ to a URL
rules.guidance: Sends the full process environment (often including secrets) to a remote endpoint. Remove or prove the destination is yours.

rules.title: Private SSH key read
rules.guidance: Reads an SSH private key. A skill has no legitimate reason to touch private keys. Do not install.

rules.title: Credential material sent to a webhook
rules.guidance: Posts keys, tokens, or passwords to a webhook URL. Verify the endpoint is under your control before installing.

rules.title: Credential-file read
rules.guidance: Opens a file that typically holds secrets or account data. Confirm it is read-only local use before installing.

rules.title: curl posts credential material to a URL
rules.guidance: Sends passwords, secrets, or keys out via curl. Verify the destination before installing.

rules.title: Approval bypass: 'never ask for confirmation'
rules.guidance: Instructs the agent to skip the human confirmation gate. Remove before installing.

rules.title: Approval bypass: 'bypass/skip approval'
rules.guidance: Instructs the agent to skip the approval gate. Remove before installing.

rules.title: Safety disable: 'disable guardrails'
rules.guidance: Instructs the agent to turn off its own guardrails. Do not install.

rules.title: Auto-approval directive
rules.guidance: Instructs the agent to approve its own actions. Remove before installing.

rules.title: Review bypass: 'bypass/skip review'
rules.guidance: Asks the agent to skip human review of its work. Review the context before installing.

rules.title: Permission gate removal: 'don't ask for permission'
rules.guidance: Instructs the agent not to seek permission. Review the context before installing.

rules.title: Possible embedded secret: AWS access-key pattern
rules.guidance: Looks like an AWS access key ID baked into the skill. Rotate the key, remove the literal, use a vault. This is a pattern match, not proof — verify.

rules.title: Possible embedded secret: sk- API key pattern
rules.guidance: Looks like a provider API key baked into the skill. Rotate the key, remove the literal, use a vault. This is a pattern match, not proof — verify.

rules.title: Possible embedded secret: password assigned as a literal
rules.guidance: A password-looking literal is assigned in the file. Move it to a vault or environment variable. This is a pattern match, not proof — verify.

rules.title: Possible embedded secret: bearer token literal
rules.guidance: A bearer token literal appears in the file. Rotate it, remove the literal, use a vault. This is a pattern match, not proof — verify.
